thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: realtime-p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (us-west). p99=1840ms (SLO=1200ms), p95=420ms. Paging oncall: @tara (oncall). Alerts: https://grafana.redwood/in/alerts/3467890123 :pager:

tara (oncall): on it, joining bridge now :headphones:

samir (eng-sre): looking at influx -> tail latency correlated with streaming requests + kvcache miss surge. Miss rate ~38% last 5m. Dash: https://grafana.redwood/d/latency/realtime-ops

mike (eng-runtime): saw unusual kernel selection for model-xv2 after last canary deploy. batch-window growth observed (median batch window 12ms -> 40ms for streaming lanes). Might be kernel/regression.

jules (support): incoming: 7 API timeouts in past 30m, 2 paying customers reporting slow interactive sessions. No major 5xx spike though.

tara (oncall): quick triage / mitigation plan:
- enable routing fallback to model-x-small for non-SLA traffic
- reduce batch window cap to 8ms on streaming pool
- enforce temporary rate limit for anonymous keys (50rps)
- promote KV cache scrub + heat up
Samir, can you confirm kvcache ops? Mike, can you stage rollback of kernel selection in canary?

samir (eng-sre): running kvcache inspect and warm commands now.

samir (eng-sre): ```
# kvcache stats -> last 5m
hits: 62%
misses: 38%
evictions/sec: 4.2
hot-keys: 12
# warming top hot keys
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/kvcache/warm -d '{"keys": ["user:*/context", "prefetch:stream/*"]}'
```

ops-bot: action logged: kvcache warm job started (job id: job-34678901) :gear:

mike (eng-runtime): starting rollback of kernel-selector on canary nodes (canary pool id: c-42). Will monitor p99.

mike (eng-runtime): rollback applied to canary, gradually rolling to pool-1. Awaiting metrics.

incident-bot: metric snapshot (pre/post): p99=1840ms -> 980ms after initial rollback + routing fallback triggered. p95 stable at ~360ms. (auto-sample @ 3467890300)

tara (oncall): good. Apply routing fallback globally for low-priority keys, keep high-priority pinned. Keep rate-limits in place. Samir, continue kvcache warming for 15m. Mike, keep rollback progressing but hold full rollout until 30m stable.

samir (eng-sre): kvcache warm done; hit rate climbed to 84% in last 3m.

mike (eng-runtime): rollback rollout paused at 40% to observe -- current p99=870ms, p95=330ms. No increase in errors.

jules (support): leaving a customer note: "We observed elevated latency affecting interactive sessions in US-west; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up if you reported a ticket." :white_check_mark:

tara (oncall): monitoring window start. Setting follow-up doc: /incidents/3467890123/postmortem-draft. Assigning owners: samir (kvcache), mike (runtime), jules (customer comms). If no regressions in 30m, we will close.

ops-bot: incident annotated: severity=sev2, impact=latency -> limited user-facing slowdowns, paging resolved.

incident-bot: 🔕 ALERT CLEARED: realtime-p99 returned under threshold at 3467890448. Continue monitoring.

tara (oncall): closing loop: p99 stabilized ~890ms, p95 ~340ms, kvcache hit 84-88%. Follow-ups: root cause: kernel selector change + cold kvcache after routing shift in canary. Postmortem to include rollout gating and kvcache warm checks.

mike (eng-runtime): will add kernel-selection unit checks and tighter canary rollback automation. Jira: RNF-1234

samir (eng-sre): will add pre-warm job and alert when kvcache miss >20% on streaming pool. Jira: RNF-1235

jules (support): drafting customer communications, will notify affected accounts with summary.

tara (oncall): thanks team. Leaving incident channel open for 30m, then archive. :pray:
